answer: Locks are recorded in tundra, expire in zenith, and orchard lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 50 aliases as a result needs 89 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 35 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
